SELECT ec.exception_case_id AS exceptionCaseId, ec.exception_type AS exceptionType, ec.severity, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, ec.title, ec.status, au.login_id AS assignedTo, ec.created_at AS createdAt, ec.source_entity_type AS sourceEntityType, ec.source_entity_id AS sourceEntityId FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user au ON au.user_id = ec.assigned_to
ORDER BY CASE ec.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ec.created_at DESC, ec.exception_case_id DESC

SELECT ec.exception_case_id AS exceptionCaseId, ec.exception_key AS exceptionKey, ec.exception_type AS exceptionType, ec.severity, ec.status, ec.title, ec.description, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, ag.agent_name AS agentName, ec.assigned_to AS assignedTo, assignee.login_id AS assigneeLoginId, ec.source_entity_type AS sourceEntityType, ec.source_entity_id AS sourceEntityId, ec.created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id LEFT JOIN fgc.agent ag ON ag.agent_id = ec.agent_id LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user assignee ON assignee.user_id = ec.assigned_to WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY CASE ec.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ec.created_at DESC, ec.exception_case_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT exception_type AS exceptionType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fgc.exception_case WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW') GROUP BY exception_type ORDER BY exception_type
